text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: "The Tenacious Tracen Cutie Collection"... You want me to be a part of this article?

text_block_list.name: Magazine Writer
text_block_list.text:
You've been drawing a lot of attention
these days
with the determined way you
run.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
I'm... incredibly honored by the offer,
however...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
(Can I really present myself in a way
suitable for a
teen magazine?)

text_block_list.name: Magazine Writer
text_block_list.text:
The truth is, my daughter really looks up
to you!
She says it's so awe-inspiring
seeing you win after
all the hard work
you've put in.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Your daughter said that?

text_block_list.name: Magazine Writer
text_block_list.text:
That's right. And it's not just her. A
growing
number of people on social
media say you inspire
them too.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
People look up to... and are inspired by
me?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
...I see.
In that case, I'm happy to do an
interview.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: So that's why you asked us to teach you how to be cute!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
That's correct. Out of all the students in
Tracen,
they specifically chose me. I
would like to do
everything I can to
meet their expectations.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Curren, people call you the missionary
for all
things cute and Fine, you're
widely beloved by
the people of Ireland.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
I decided to speak with you both, as I
cannot
think of anyone more
appropriate to ask for the
help I need.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
If you're sure you want my help, then I'm
happy to
be of service! Although I'm not
sure what I can
teach you about being
cute.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Let's see... Why don't we just do what we
usually
do? ♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
#studying #cuteness with #Ikuno in
#CuteTown ☆
There, that should do
it! ♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Hmmm... The rainbow parfaits are nice,
but these
new animal crepes might be
better for a group
selfie...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
I see. One must consider many factors in
order to
make the most attractive
picture, from coloring
to shape to
potential popularity.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Why, hello there, little guys! ♪ I've
never seen
such specimens, even back in
Ireland.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Hm. So I must never let my smile falter,
no matter
who or what I'm speaking to...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Over here! ♪ Let's get a shot of all three
of us in
front of this field of flowers!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Sure.
I must calculate how to make the
picture as
visually appealing as possible
and keep a
constant smile.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Hm... After analyzing the cuteness
factor, I think I
achieved some measure
of success. However, I
still feel a
lingering awkwardness in myself.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
If either of you sees anything strange
about me or
anything I can improve on
from your perspective,
please point it
out to me.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Wait, no way. Don't tell me you haven't
noticed,
Ikuno.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
You've already blown me away with your

cuteness! ♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Cuteness is the language of feelings.
And when
cuteness interacts with
cuteness, the whole world
will fill up
with cuteness! ♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
By working so hard to understand
cuteness,
you've communicated the
greatest kind of
cuteness! It's made me
even cuter just by seeing
it!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
She's right! I felt your cuteness with
perfect clarity
while watching you do
your best!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Everyone has their own kind of
cuteness... And
yours is just wonderful,
Ikuno.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: You two...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A few days later, Ikuno Dictus tries her
hand at
the magazine interview.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Look at this! It reads, "Cute and hardworking, the fruits of Ikuno Dictus's studies are evident in her flawless execution of a heart pose."

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, you're trending on Umatter too! ♪
It looks
like your cuteness came through
loud and clear!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Thank you. I worked incredibly hard at
it, so I'm
glad that people have
accepted me.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Cuteness is something both fun and
joyful... You
two were the ones who
taught me that.
